infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MotoPilot uses your location to show your position on the map and provide turn-by-turn navigation while riding.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MotoPilot needs background location access to keep navigation and live group ride tracking running while the screen is mounted and locked.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: MotoPilot needs background location access to keep navigation and live group ride tracking running.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: MotoPilot connects to your Cardo/intercom headset to read battery level and manage audio routing.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: MotoPilot communicates with your Bluetooth headset to monitor connection and battery status.
infoPlist.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: MotoPilot controls Apple Music playback inside the dashboard so you don't have to switch apps while riding.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MotoPilot needs microphone access to handle in-app calls through your connected headset.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: MotoPilot reads contacts to display caller names on the high-contrast call overlay.
